verdict.rationale: Plausible API keys can be scoped to a single team, which determines the sites they can query. The Stats API they access is read-only, so a key handed to an agent cannot modify data. That gives coarse least-privilege, but the evidence shows no finer per-key controls. Missing for 10: per-site or per-endpoint permission scopes, key expiry/rotation or revocation controls, agent-specific credential guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
